observations: The page number «66» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01-L02 complete the sentence that ends p. 65 (JP2 0097, L38), «dass er dem Sūrya-Siddhānta und dem». L11-L12: the heading of chapter 22, in bold, centred, with the reference to the text below it; «57a», the a raised.

L03-L10: the note of C is the bracketed addition to chapter 21 on p. 16 of the Latin text (JP2 0048, L01-L10), whose «1350 (sic! recte 355)» note 2 corrects. L06-L08. Checked: 365 + 14/60 + 48/3600 = 365.24667 days, and 0.24667 days are 5h 55m 12s. L07: the fractions 14/60 and 48/3600 built up within the line, written {fr:NUMERATOR|DENOMINATOR}; L06 and L08 the d, h, m and s raised.

A figure stands at the left of L26-L31, which are set in a narrower measure at its right; it is not reproduced. An arc, concave downward, labelled «Ekliptik» in italics along its left part, with C and S on it; M above C, joined to C by a short vertical line and to S by a straight line. The letters M, C, S are italic.

L26-L33: al-Battānī's rule (Nallino I, 87): the square of the difference of the true longitudes of the sun and the moon plus the square of the moon's latitude is about the square of the moon's distance from the sun. Checked: in the triangle M C S, small and nearly plane, right-angled at C, MS² = CS² + MC². L33: the formula, displayed and centred, with a full stop after it: «∽», a sign like a letter S lying on its side with its ends curled, the sign of approximate equality, transcribed ∽ (U+223D); the radical is printed as a V-shaped sign with a bar over «CS² + MC²», written {rt:…}; M, S, C italic.

L13-L18: the passage of al-Bīrūnī's Chronology in German quotation marks; «Ḥabash’ des Rechners», Ḥabash al-Ḥāsib, spaced, with the dot under the Ḥ and the apostrophe of the genitive. L35-L36: the quotation of chapter 22 of the Latin text (p. 16, JP2 0048), in German, continued on p. 67. L02 «endgiltig» and L32 «ohne weiters», as printed.

L26: before «des» a thin mark like a bracket, «[», lighter than the print, of spacing material that came up to the height of the type; not transcribed. L09 and L12: the dash of «Ptol. — Eigentümlich» long, with a space on either side, and that of «16—17» long and set close, both printed in two pieces; N04: «85—92», the long dash of the small type of the notes (31 px, with gaps of 6 and 8 px); N05: «265–272», the short dash (26 px, with gaps of 10 and 9 px).
Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Ptol.», «Kh.», «Al-Bīrūnī», «Al-Battānīs», «Ḥabash», «Batt.», «Schiaparelli», «Nallino», «Sachau»; italics: «Ārya-Siddhānta», «Chronologie», the letters of the formula.
The colons and semicolons stand after the thin space of the edition (10-12 px measured).
